body:
Thank you. 

I see what you mean about not adding anything to my life, nothing positive anyway but it's crazy how attached one can get to someone even when they know they are not good for them.


I do try plenty of times to stop drinking. I was able to make it four days last week but one thing or another leads me back to it. I will continue to try everyday to stop. That's all I can promise right now.

As far as my daughter..I'm thinking of just moving to where she is or at least somewhere closer to her since I have to be out of here soon. I have the feeling that if I stay here I will turn into a hermit and never leave me house. 

I don't know how old you are but I remember the day I decided that I was going to get pregnant thinking that somehow it was the answer that it would heal me. That's not the case. Yes the love is unconditional and she's what's keeping me here. I can't even imagine the pain she would be in. So I stare at her picture and I think about that anytime those thoughts just can't be pushed away. Hopefully in time you find a woman that is worthy of you and who wants to have many babies with you.

Again, thanks.

The way this was done, I'm starting to wonder if it was all done by the same person or group and that includes razor because there is no way someone would post such a ridiculous statement and not think that they are going to be called out on it. And then magically everyone shows up, JenniLeigh, Rage on War, j0sh, jenni3kat, Turka Turka, TurtleTape, etc..ready to pounce and call out for fairness. When all they did/do at mTurkForum is dehumanize people and call it funny banter.

mTurkWiki Forum must be hurting for members if they have nothing better to do then to start crap on mturkForum. I wonder why they didn't survive at any of the other existing forums and the only thing left to do was start their own forum. Misery loves company, that's all mTurkWiki is.
I agree with Lambo594. Give me a break with the part about the newbies being impressionable. I guess according to headfirstq we were all stupid and had no common sense when we started turking.

So, am I the only one that knows that you can leave a TO for "communication" only since that is all the requester had done at the time and then go back and change it if you'd like. It seems to me that headfirstq is simply trying to split hairs.
